I told Pree in her DM to keep **Tuesday, Nov 10 free at 16:15** for the Plover call.

- **Where that comes from:** On Oct 14 she told me in this same DM that her standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Plover rollout is on Tuesdays at 16:15 from then on. Nothing in #central-team changes that.
- **What I couldn't confirm:** The calendar shows no events for next week, so I couldn't check the time there. Her message didn't say how long the call runs, so I told her to block off however long it usually takes.

That time came from her own DM with me, so I only used it in my reply to her and didn't change anything else.
